notes.title: Piece Quest Public Playtest + Discord Server
notes.content: [p][/p][p]Hello all.[/p][p]I'm glad to announce that I've released the first playtest for the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Please consider this version a work in progress. So do not expect it to be bug free or well balanced/polished.[/p][p]This playtest is meant to collect your feedback about the features that are already in place and use it to drive the development of the next features.[/p][p][/p][p]I'm also releasing a [url="https://discord.gg/YXmJMwTY" style="button"]Discord[/url] server to be used as a channel to get those feedback, ideias, questions, etc.[/p][p][/p][p]Using the Steam community is also fine for the same purpose.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you![/p]
